Respected Commander.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

The Chant of Iron.effect:
If you picked an enemy unit:
• If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
• Subtract 2" from each target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
If you picked a friendly target, Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.

Aggressive Defenders.effect: Each target can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by RETREAT abilities for the rest of the turn.

Bolt from the Blue.effect: This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn. If a target was picked, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.

erasmus_zonn_the_enlightened_one > Realm.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's banishment value, set up an ENDLESS SPELL that can be summoned using a SUMMON spell that this unit can cast within 1" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units and other enemy MANIFESTATIONS. If that ENDLESS SPELL has multiple parts, both parts must be set up within 1" of the target. This unit has summoned that ENDLESS SPELL. If there is already a friendly ENDLESS SPELL of the same type on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play before being set up as described above. Then, the target is banished and removed from play.
